regions.label: plain_text
regions.text:
The July number of THE CRISIS will be a vacation number. It will contain an article on Colored Athletes by Edwin B. Henderson, of Washington, D. C., illustrated by photographs of many celebrated men. There will also be an analysis of the segregation situation in the city of Baltimore.

This is to certify that I print twelve thousand copies of the June Crisis, 1911.

ROBERT N. WOOD, Printer,
202 East 99th St.

Sworn to before me this 17th day of May, 1911.

P. J. BURKE,
Notary Public, N. Y. C.
